newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 24.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 24.

text.p: All Mexican ports were reported open Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Northern Baja California, Chihuahua, Sonora and Sinaloa states cloudy with probable light rains. Winds at maximum 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) from the west and northwest with waves four to six feet high.

Weak cold front moving west from southern Florida peninsula and likely to draw rains along the northeast Gulf of Mexico region, the coasts of Tamaulipas, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula. Maximum winds expected from 10 to 20 knots with waves four to six feet high.
Hot and moderately cloudy with scattered showers, moderate eastern and southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
